titles.title: Farmers Lifeline Options for Overcoming Disasters (FLOOD) Act
Farmers Lifeline Options for Overcoming Disasters (FLOOD) Act

A bill to amend the Food Security Act of 1985 to add the emergency watershed program as a covered program for purposes of carrying out the regional conservation partnership program, and for other purposes.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Agriculture, Nutrition, and Forestry.
